title: Genesis 22:3 — “young men” is naar (נער): boy, young man, servant
summary: Genesis 22:3 under the heading “The Akedah” (Abraham rises early, takes two young men and Isaac, splits wood). The phrase “took two of his young men with him” is in green, matched to the Hebrew word naar (נער), meaning boy, young man, servant.

text.text: 3 So Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him and Isaac his son; and he split wood for the burnt offering, and arose and went to the place of which God had told him.
